body.translated_text: The Manual of the Procedure for Remembering the Pastimes of <s>Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa</s> in the Eight Time Periods

children.text: evaṃ padmopari dhyātvā rādhā-kṛṣṇau tatas tayoḥ /
children.translated_text: Having thus meditated upon <s>Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> above the lotus, then for those two,

children.text: aṣṭa-kālocitāṃ sevāṃ vidadhyāt siddha-dehataḥ /
children.translated_text: one should render service appropriate to the eight time periods, with the <s>siddha-deha</s> (perfected spiritual body);

children.text: guru-vargājñayā tatra pūjayed rādhikā-harī // RKK_1 //
children.translated_text: by the command of the <s>guru-varga</s> (succession of spiritual masters), one should worship <s>Rādhikā</s> and <s>Hari</s> therein. // RKK_1 //

children.text: bāhya-pūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pādyam arghyaṃ krameṇa ca /
children.translated_text: Then, having performed the external worship, <s>pādya</s> (foot-washing water) and <s>arghya</s> (offering water) in sequence,

children.text: vidhi-pūrvaka-śuśrūṣā-nantaraṃ sādhakaḥ kramāt /
children.translated_text: after the prescribed respectful service, the practitioner should, in order,

children.text: dvātriṃśad-akṣara-mukhānj apen mantrān atandritaḥ // RKK_2 //
children.translated_text: chant the <s>mantras</s> beginning with the thirty-two syllables, without laziness. // RKK_2 //

children.text: mahā-mantraṃ japed ādau daśārṇaṃ tad-antaram /
children.translated_text: One should first chant the <s>mahā-mantra</s> (great mantra), then the ten-syllabled [mantra],

children.text: tataḥ śrī-rādhikā-mantraṃ gāyatrīṃ kāmikīṃ tataḥ // RKK_3 //
children.translated_text: then the <s>mantra</s> of <s>Śrī Rādhikā</s>, then the <s>kāmikī gāyatrī</s>. // RKK_3 //

children.text: tato yugala-mantraṃ ca japed rāsa-sthalī-pradam /
children.translated_text: Then one should chant the <s>yugala-mantra</s> (couple-mantra), which bestows the <s>rāsa-sthalī</s> (place of the rāsa dance);

children.text: tato 'ṣṭānāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca japen mantrān yathā-kramam /
children.translated_text: then one should chant the <s>mantras</s> of the eight <s>sakhīs</s> (companions) in order,

children.text: tato 'ṣṭa-mañjarīṇāṃ ca sva-sva-mantrān kramāj japet // RKK_4 //
children.translated_text: then one should chant the respective <s>mantras</s> of the eight <s>mañjarīs</s> in sequence. // RKK_4 //

children.text: aṣṭa-kālīya-sūtram āha, yathā--
children.translated_text: He states the formula of the eight time periods, as follows—

children.text: niśāntaḥ prātaḥ pūrvāhno madhyāhnaś cāparāhnakaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Niśānta</s> (late night), <s>prātaḥ</s> (morning), <s>pūrvāhna</s> (forenoon), <s>madhyāhna</s> (midday), and <s>aparāhna</s> (afternoon),

children.text: sāyaṃ pradoṣo rātriś ca kālā aṣṭau yathā-kramam // RKK_5 //
children.translated_text: <s>sāyam</s> (evening), <s>pradoṣa</s> (early night), and <s>rātri</s> (night)—these are the eight time periods in order. // RKK_5 //

children.text: madhyāhno yāminī cobhau ṣaṇ-muhūrta-mitau smṛtau /
children.translated_text: Midday and night, both, are measured at six <s>muhūrtas</s>;

children.text: tri-muhūrta-mitā jñeyā niśānta-pramukhāḥ pare // RKK_6 //
children.translated_text: the others, beginning with late night, should be known as measured at three <s>muhūrtas</s> each. // RKK_6 //

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca-
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Nārada</s> said—

children.text: bhagavan sarvam ākhyātaṃ yad yat pṛṣṭhaṃ tvayā guro /
children.translated_text: O Blessed One, everything that was asked by me has been told by you, O <s>Guru</s>;

children.text: adhunā śrotum icchāmi rāga-mārgam anuttamam // RKK_7 //
children.translated_text: now I wish to hear the unsurpassed <s>rāga-mārga</s> (path of spontaneous devotion). // RKK_7 //

body.translated_text: Regarding service during those [periods] with the <s>siddha-deha</s> (perfected spiritual body), as in the <s>Sanat-kumāra Saṃhitā</s>:

children.text: śrī-sadāśiva uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Sadāśiva</s> said—

children.text: sādhu pṛṣṭhaṃ tvayā vipra sarva-loka-hitaiṣiṇā /
children.translated_text: Well asked by you, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, who desires the welfare of all worlds;

children.text: rahasyam api vakṣyāmi tan me nigaditaṃ śṛṇu // RKK_8 //
children.translated_text: I shall speak even the secret—hear that which was spoken by me. // RKK_8 //

children.text: parakīyābhimāninyas tathāsya ca priyā janāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who regard themselves as <s>parakīyā</s> (belonging to another) and also his beloved people,

children.text: pracureṇaiva bhāvena ramayanti nija-priyam // RKK_9 //
children.translated_text: with an abundance of devotional sentiment, they delight their own beloved. // RKK_9 //

children.text: ātmānaṃ cintayet tatra tāsāṃ madhye manoramām /
children.translated_text: One should contemplate oneself there, among them, as a beautiful

children.text: rūpa-yauvana-sampannāṃ kiśorīṃ pramadākṛtim // RKK_10 //
children.translated_text: young maiden, endowed with beauty and youth, of captivating form, // RKK_10 //

children.text: nānā-śilpa-kalābhijñāṃ kṛṣṇa-bhogānurūpiṇīm /
children.translated_text: skilled in various arts and crafts, suited to the enjoyment of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: prārthitām api kṛṣṇena tato bhoga-parāṅ-mukhīm // RKK_11 //
children.translated_text: yet even when desired by <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, averse to [direct] enjoyment with Him. // RKK_11 //

children.text: rādhikānucarīṃ nityaṃ tat-sevana-parāyaṇām /
children.translated_text: Always a follower of <s>Rādhikā</s>, devoted to Her service,

children.text: kṛṣṇād apy adhikaṃ prema rādhikāyāṃ prakurvatīm // RKK_12 //
children.translated_text: bestowing upon <s>Rādhikā</s> even greater love than upon <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, // RKK_12 //

children.text: prītyānudivasaṃ yatnāt tayoḥ saṅgama-kāriṇīm /
children.translated_text: daily and lovingly arranging the meeting of those two with effort,

children.text: tat-sevana-sukhāsvāda-bhareṇātisunirvṛtām // RKK_13 //
children.translated_text: supremely fulfilled by the weight of the bliss of tasting Their service. // RKK_13 //

children.text: ity ātmānaṃ vicintyaiva tatra sevāṃ samācaret /
children.translated_text: Having thus contemplated oneself, one should perform service there,

children.text: brāhma-muhūrtam ārabhya yāvat sāntā mahā-niśā // RKK_14 //
children.translated_text: beginning from the <s>brāhma-muhūrta</s> (pre-dawn hour) until the great night comes to an end. // RKK_14 //

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Nārada</s> said—

children.text: harer atra gatāṃ līlāṃ śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ /
children.translated_text: I wish to hear the truth about <s>Hari's</s> pastimes performed here;

children.text: līlām ajānatāṃ sevyo manasā tu kathaṃ hariḥ // RKK_15 //
children.translated_text: for those who do not know the pastimes, how can <s>Hari</s> be served in the mind? // RKK_15 //

children.text: śrī-sadāśiva uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Sadāśiva</s> said—

children.text: nāhaṃ jānāmi tāṃ līlāṃ harer nārada tattvataḥ /
children.translated_text: I do not know those pastimes of <s>Hari</s> in truth, O <s>Nārada</s>;

children.text: vṛndā-devīṃ samāgaccha sā te līlāṃ pravakṣyati // RKK_16 //
children.translated_text: approach <s>Vṛndā-devī</s>—she will narrate the pastimes to you. // RKK_16 //

children.text: avidūre itaḥ sthānāt keśī-tīrtha-samīpataḥ /
children.translated_text: Not far from this place, near <s>Keśī-tīrtha</s>,

children.text: sakhībhiḥ saṃvṛtā sāste govinda-paricārikā // RKK_17 //
children.translated_text: she resides, surrounded by <s>sakhīs</s> (companions), the attendant of <s>Govinda</s>. // RKK_17 //

children.text: śrī-sanat-kumāra uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Sanat-kumāra</s> said—

children.text: ity uktas taṃ parikramya guruṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus told, having circumambulated and bowed repeatedly to the <s>Guru</s>,

children.text: vṛndā-sthānaṃ jagāmāsau nārado muni-sattamaḥ // RKK_18 //
children.translated_text: <s>Nārada</s>, the best of sages, went to the abode of <s>Vṛndā</s>. // RKK_18 //

children.text: vṛndāpi nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyāpi punaḥ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vṛndā</s> too, seeing <s>Nārada</s>, bowing again and again,

children.text: uvāca taṃ muni-śreṣṭhaṃ katham atrāgatis tava // RKK_19 //
children.translated_text: spoke to that best of sages: 'What brings you here?' // RKK_19 //

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Nārada</s> said—

children.text: tvatto veditum icchāmi naityikaṃ caritaṃ hareḥ /
children.translated_text: I wish to learn from you the daily activities of <s>Hari</s>;

children.text: tad ādito mama bruhi yadi yogyo 'smi śobhane // RKK_20 //
children.translated_text: tell me from the beginning, if I am worthy, O beautiful one. // RKK_20 //

children.text: śrī-vṛndā-devy uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Vṛndā-devī</s> said—

children.text: rahasyaṃ tvāṃ pravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇa-bhakto 'si nārada /
children.translated_text: I shall tell you the secret, O <s>Nārada</s>, for you are a devotee of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>;

children.text: na prakāśyaṃ tvayā hy etad guhyād guhyataraṃ mahat // RKK_21 //
children.translated_text: this should not be disclosed by you, for it is a great secret, more secret than the secret. // RKK_21 //

children.text: atha niśānta-sevā--
children.translated_text: Now the service of <s>niśānta</s> (late night/predawn)—

children.text: madhye vṛndāvane ramye pañcāśat-kuñja-maṇḍite /
children.translated_text: In the midst of lovely <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, adorned with fifty groves,

children.text: kalpa-vṛkṣa-nikuñje tu divya-ratna-maye gṛhe // RKK_22 //
children.translated_text: in a bower of <s>kalpa-vṛkṣas</s> (wish-fulfilling trees), in a divine house made of jewels, // RKK_22 //

children.text: nidritau tiṣṭhatas talpe niviḍāliṅgitau mithaḥ /
children.translated_text: the two sleep on a couch, tightly embracing each other;

children.text: mad-ājñā-kāribhiḥ paścāt pakṣibhir bodhitāv api // RKK_23 //
children.translated_text: though awakened by birds acting on my command, // RKK_23 //

children.text: gāḍhāliṅgana-nirbhedam āptau tad-bhaṅga-kātarau /
children.translated_text: having attained the inseparability of a deep embrace, distressed at its breaking,

children.text: na manas kurutas talpāt samutthātuṃ manāg api // RKK_24 //
children.translated_text: they do not in the slightest incline their minds to rise from the couch. // RKK_24 //

children.text: tataś ca śārikā-saṃghaiḥ śukādyair api tau muhuḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, by flocks of <s>śārikā</s> (myna) birds, parrots, and others, those two, repeatedly

children.text: bodhitau vividhaiḥ padyaiḥ sva-talpād udatiṣṭhatām // RKK_25 //
children.translated_text: awakened with various verses, arose from their couch. // RKK_25 //

children.text: upaviṣṭau tato dṛṣṭvā sakhyas talpe mudānvitau /
children.translated_text: Then the <s>sakhīs</s>, seeing the two seated joyfully on the couch,

children.text: praviśya cakrire sevāṃ tat-kālasyocitāṃ tayoḥ // RKK_26 //
children.translated_text: entered and performed service appropriate to that time for them. // RKK_26 //

children.text: punaś ca śārikā-vākyair utthāya tau sva-talpataḥ /
children.translated_text: And again, by the words of the myna birds, having risen from their couch,

children.text: gacchataḥ sva-sva-bhavanaṃ bhīty-utkaṇṭhākulau mithaḥ // RKK_27 //
children.translated_text: they go to their respective homes, agitated by fear and longing for each other. // RKK_27 //

children.text: atha prātaḥ-sevā--
children.translated_text: Now the morning service—

children.text: prātaś ca bodhito mātrā talpād utthāya satvaram /
children.translated_text: In the morning, awakened by His mother, rising swiftly from the couch,

children.text: kṛtvā kṛṣṇo danta-kāṣṭhaṃ baladeva-samanvitaḥ // RKK_28 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, having cleaned His teeth, accompanied by <s>Baladeva</s>, // RKK_28 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the <s>niśānta</s> service.

children.text: mātrānumodito yāti gośālāṃ dohanotsukaḥ /
children.translated_text: encouraged by His mother, goes to the cowshed, eager to milk;

children.text: rādhāpi bodhitā vṛddha-vayasyābhiḥ sva-talpataḥ // RKK_29 //
children.translated_text: <s>Rādhā</s> too, awakened by elderly companions, from Her couch, // RKK_29 //

children.text: utthāya danta-kāṣṭhādi kṛtvābhyaṅga samācaret /
children.translated_text: rising, having cleaned Her teeth and so forth, She performs the oil massage;

children.text: snāna-vedīṃ tato gatvā snāpitā lalitādibhiḥ // RKK_30 //
children.translated_text: then going to the bathing platform, She is bathed by <s>Lalitā</s> and the others. // RKK_30 //

children.text: bhūṣā-gṛhaṃ vrajet tatra vayasyā bhūṣayanty api /
children.translated_text: She goes to the dressing room; there the companions adorn Her

children.text: bhūṣaṇair vividhair divyair gandha-mālyānulepanaiḥ // RKK_31 //
children.translated_text: with various divine ornaments, fragrances, garlands, and ointments. // RKK_31 //

children.text: tataś ca sva-janais tasyāḥ śvaśrūṃ samprārthya yatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, Her relatives having earnestly requested Her mother-in-law,

children.text: paktum āhūyate tūrṇaṃ sa-sakhī sā yaśodayā // RKK_32 //
children.translated_text: She is quickly summoned with Her companions by <s>Yaśodā</s> to cook. // RKK_32 //

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Nārada</s> said—

children.text: katham āhūyate devi pākārthaṃ sā yaśodayā /
children.translated_text: How is She summoned by <s>Yaśodā</s> for cooking, O Goddess,

children.text: satīṣu pāka-kartrīṣu rohiṇī-pramukhāṣv api // RKK_33 //
children.translated_text: when there are [other] cooks present, such as <s>Rohiṇī</s> and others? // RKK_33 //

children.text: śrī-vṛndovāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Vṛndā</s> said—

children.text: durvāsasā svayaṃ datto varas tasyai maharṣiṇā /
children.translated_text: A boon was given to Her by <s>Durvāsas</s> himself, the great sage;

children.text: iti kātyāyanī-vaktrāc chrutam āsīn mayā purā // RKK_34 //
children.translated_text: thus I heard formerly from the mouth of <s>Kātyāyanī</s>: // RKK_34 //

children.text: tvayā yat pacyate devi tad-annaṃ mad-anugrahāt /
children.translated_text: 'Whatever food is cooked by you, O Goddess, by my grace,

children.text: miṣṭaṃ svādv-amṛta-sparddhi bhoktur āyuṣkaraṃ tathā // RKK_35 //
children.translated_text: will be sweet, delicious, rivaling nectar, and life-giving to the eater.' // RKK_35 //

children.text: ity āhvayati tāṃ nityaṃ yaśodā putra-vatsalā /
children.translated_text: Therefore <s>Yaśodā</s>, devoted to her son, always summons Her,

children.text: āyuṣmān me bhavet putraḥ svādu-lobhāt tathā satī // RKK_36 //
children.translated_text: [thinking] 'may my son be long-lived,' out of greed for delicious [food], and She, being virtuous [comes]. // RKK_36 //

children.text: śvaśrvānumoditā sāpi hṛṣṭā nandālayaṃ vrajet /
children.translated_text: She, permitted by Her mother-in-law, goes joyfully to <s>Nanda's</s> house,

children.text: sa-sakhī-prakarā tatra gatvā pākaṃ karoti ca // RKK_37 //
children.translated_text: accompanied by a multitude of <s>sakhīs</s>; having gone there, She cooks. // RKK_37 //

children.text: kṛṣṇo 'pi dugdhvā gāḥ kāścid dohayitvā janaiḥ parāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> too, having milked some cows and having others milked by servants,

children.text: āgacchati pitur vākyāt sva-gṛhaṃ sakhibhir vṛtaḥ // RKK_38 //
children.translated_text: returns to His own house at His father's word, surrounded by companions. // RKK_38 //

children.text: abhyaṅga-mardanaṃ kṛtvā dāsaiḥ saṃsnāpito mudā /
children.translated_text: Having been massaged with oil and bathed joyfully by servants,

children.text: dhauta-vastra-dharaḥ sragvī candanākta-kalevaraḥ // RKK_39 //
children.translated_text: wearing freshly washed garments, garlanded, His body anointed with sandalwood, // RKK_39 //

children.text: dvi-phāla-baddha-keśaiś ca grīvā-bhālopari sphuran /
children.translated_text: with hair tied in two braids shining upon His neck and forehead,

children.text: candrākāra-sphurad-bhāla-tilakālaka-rañjitaḥ // RKK_40 //
children.translated_text: adorned with a moon-shaped tilaka mark and a curling lock on His radiant forehead, // RKK_40 //

children.text: kaṅkaṇāṅgada-keyūra-ratna-mudrālasat-karaḥ /
children.translated_text: His hands gleaming with bracelets, armlets, armbands, and jeweled rings,

children.text: muktāhāra-sphurad-vakṣā makarākṛti-kuṇḍalaḥ // RKK_41 //
children.translated_text: His chest shining with a pearl necklace, wearing makara-shaped earrings, // RKK_41 //

children.text: muhur ākārito mātrā praviśed bhojanālaye /
children.translated_text: repeatedly called by His mother, He would enter the dining hall,

children.text: avalambya karaṃ mātur baladevam anuvrataḥ // RKK_42 //
children.translated_text: holding His mother's hand, followed by <s>Baladeva</s>. // RKK_42 //

children.text: bhuktvā ca vividhānnāni mātrā ca sakhibhir vṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having eaten various foods, surrounded by His mother and companions,

children.text: hāsayan vividhair vākyaiḥ sakhīṃs tair hāsitaḥ svayam // RKK_43 //
children.translated_text: making the companions laugh with various witticisms, and Himself made to laugh by them, // RKK_43 //

children.text: itthaṃ bhuktvā tathācamya divya-khaṭṭopari kṣaṇāt /
children.translated_text: having thus eaten and rinsed His mouth, on a divine bed for a moment,

children.text: viśramet sevakair dattaṃ tāmbūlaṃ vibhajann adan // RKK_44 //
children.translated_text: He rests, dividing and eating the <s>tāmbūla</s> (betel-leaf) given by servants. // RKK_44 //

children.text: rādhāpi bhojanānandaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaśodayāhūta /
children.translated_text: <s>Rādhā</s> too, seeing the joy of the meal, summoned by <s>Yaśodā</s>,

children.text: lalitādi-sakhī-vṛtā bhuṅkte 'nnaṃ lajjayānvitā // RKK_45 //
children.translated_text: surrounded by <s>Lalitā</s> and other <s>sakhīs</s>, eats the food with bashfulness. // RKK_45 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the morning service.

children.text: atha pūrvāhna-sevā--
children.translated_text: Now the forenoon service—

children.text: gopa-veśa-dharaḥ kṛṣṇo dhenu-vṛnda-puraḥ-saraḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, wearing the dress of a cowherd, at the head of the herd of cows,

children.text: vraja-vāsi-janaiḥ prītyā sarvair anugataḥ pathi // RKK_46 //
children.translated_text: lovingly followed by all the residents of <s>Vraja</s> on the path, // RKK_46 //

children.text: pitaraṃ mātaraṃ natvā netrāntena priyā-gaṇān /
children.translated_text: having bowed to His father and mother, [glancing at] the groups of beloveds from the corner of His eye,

children.text: yathāyogyaṃ tathā cānyān sannivartya vanaṃ vrajet // RKK_47 //
children.translated_text: making others turn back as appropriate, He goes to the forest. // RKK_47 //

children.text: vanaṃ praviśya sakhibhiḥ krīḍitvā ca kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ /
children.translated_text: Having entered the forest and played with His companions for a moment, then

children.text: vañcayitvā ca tān sarvān dvi-traiḥ priya-sakhair yutaḥ // RKK_48 //
children.translated_text: having deceived all of them, accompanied by two or three dear friends, // RKK_48 //

children.text: saṅketakaṃ vrajed dharṣāt priyā-sandarśanotsukaḥ /
children.translated_text: He boldly goes to the rendezvous, eager to see His beloved;

children.text: sāpi kṛṣṇe vanaṃ yāte dṛṣṭvā taṃ gṛham āgatā // RKK_49 //
children.translated_text: and She, when <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> has gone to the forest, having seen Him return [in her mind], // RKK_49 //

children.text: sūryādi-pūjā-vyājena kusumādy-āhṛti-cchalāt /
children.translated_text: on the pretext of worshipping <s>Sūrya</s> and others, under the guise of gathering flowers and such,

children.text: vañcayitvā gurūn yāti priya-saṅgecchayā vanaṃ // RKK_50 //
children.translated_text: having deceived the elders, goes to the forest with the desire to meet Her beloved. // RKK_50 //

children.text: atha madhyāhna-sevā--
children.translated_text: Now the midday service—

children.text: itthaṃ tau bahu-yatnena militvā sva-gaṇair vṛtau /
children.translated_text: Thus having met with great effort, the two, surrounded by their respective companions,

children.text: vihārair vividhais tatra vane vikrīḍato mudā // RKK_51 //
children.translated_text: Playing joyfully there in the forest with various pastimes, // RKK_51 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the forenoon service.

children.text: syandolikā-samārūḍhau sakhībhir dolitau kvacit /
children.translated_text: Sometimes the two, mounted upon a swing, are swung by the <s>sakhīs</s> (female companions);

children.text: kvacid veṇuṃ kara-srastaṃ priyayā coritaṃ hariḥ // RKK_52 //
children.translated_text: Sometimes <s>Hari</s> searches for His flute, which has slipped from His hand, stolen by His beloved. // RKK_52 //

children.text: anveṣayann upālabdho vipralabdhaḥ priyā-gaṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Searching for it, He is reproached and deceived by the groups of beloveds;

children.text: hāsito bahudhā tābhir hṛta-sva iva tiṣṭhati // RKK_53 //
children.translated_text: Made to laugh in many ways by them, He stands as if robbed of His possessions. // RKK_53 //

children.text: vasanta-ṛtunā juṣṭaṃ vana-khaṇḍaṃ kvacin mudā /
children.translated_text: Sometimes, joyfully entering a forest grove graced by the spring season,

children.text: praviśya candanāmbhobhiḥ kuṅkumādi-jalair api // RKK_54 //
children.translated_text: With waters of sandalwood and liquids of <s>kuṅkuma</s> (saffron) and other substances, // RKK_54 //

children.text: viṣiñcato yantra-muktais tat-paṅkenāpi tau mithaḥ /
children.translated_text: The two sprinkle each other with those, released from syringes, and also with the resulting paste;

children.text: sakhyo 'py evaṃ viṣiñcanti tāś ca tau siñcataḥ punaḥ // RKK_55 //
children.translated_text: The <s>sakhīs</s> (companions) likewise sprinkle them, and the two in turn sprinkle those companions. // RKK_55 //

children.text: tathānyartusu juṣṭāsu krīḍato vana-rājiṣu /
children.translated_text: Similarly, in forest groves graced by other seasons, they play

children.text: tat-tat-kālocitair nānā-vihāraiḥ sa-gaṇau dvija // RKK_56 //
children.translated_text: With various pastimes suited to each particular time, together with their companions, O <s>dvija</s> (twice-born one). // RKK_56 //

children.text: śrāntau kvacid vṛkṣa-mūlam āsādya muni-sattama /
children.translated_text: Fatigued at times, having reached the base of a tree, O best of sages,

children.text: upaviśyāsane divye madhu-pānaṃ pracakratuḥ // RKK_57 //
children.translated_text: They sit upon a divine seat and partake of <s>madhu-pāna</s> (honey-drink). // RKK_57 //

children.text: tato madhu-madonmattau nidrayā mīlitekṣaṇau /
children.translated_text: Then, intoxicated by the honey-drink, their eyes closing with drowsiness,

children.text: mithaḥ pāṇiṃ samālambya kāma-bāṇa-vaśaṅgatau // RKK_58 //
children.translated_text: Holding each other's hands, overcome by the arrows of <s>Kāma</s> (the god of love), // RKK_58 //

children.text: riraṃsu viśataḥ kuñjaṃ skhalat-pādābjakau pathi /
children.translated_text: Desiring amorous sport, they enter a bower, their lotus-feet stumbling on the path;

children.text: tato vikrīḍatas tatra kariṇī-yūthapau yathā // RKK_59 //
children.translated_text: Then they sport there like a bull elephant with his she-elephant. // RKK_59 //

children.text: sakhyo 'pi madhubhir mattā nidrayā pihitekṣaṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>sakhīs</s> too, intoxicated by the honey-drink, their eyes closed with sleep,

children.text: abhitaḥ kuñja-puñjeṣu sārvā eva vililyire // RKK_60 //
children.translated_text: All of them conceal themselves in clusters of bowers on every side. // RKK_60 //

children.text: pṛthag ekena vapuṣā kṛṣṇo 'pi yugapad vibhuḥ /
children.translated_text: And <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the all-pervading Lord, simultaneously assuming separate forms for each,

children.text: sarvāsāṃ sannidhiṃ gacchet priyāṇāṃ parito muhuḥ // RKK_61 //
children.translated_text: Goes into the presence of all His beloveds, surrounding them again and again. // RKK_61 //

children.text: ramayitvā ca tāḥ sarvāḥ kariṇī-gajarāḍ iva /
children.translated_text: Having delighted them all, like the king of elephants with his she-elephants,

children.text: priyayā ca tathā tābhiḥ sarovaram athāvrajet // RKK_62 //
children.translated_text: Together with His beloved and with those companions, He then proceeds to the lake. // RKK_62 //

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Nārada</s> said:

children.text: vṛnde śrī-nanda-putrasya mādhurya-krīḍane katham /
children.translated_text: O <s>Vṛndā</s>, how in the sweet amorous play of the son of <s>Śrī Nanda</s>

children.text: aiśvaryasya prakāśo 'bhūd iti me chindhi saṃśayam // RKK_63 //
children.translated_text: Was there a manifestation of <s>aiśvarya</s> (divine majesty)? Please dispel this doubt of mine. // RKK_63 //

children.text: śrī-vṛndovāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Vṛndā</s> said:

children.text: mune mādhurya-mayy asti līlā-śaktir harer dṛśā /
children.translated_text: O sage, <s>Hari</s> possesses a <s>līlā-śakti</s> (pastime-potency) that is full of <s>mādhurya</s> (sweetness);

children.text: tayā pṛthak-kṛtaḥ krīḍed gopikābhiḥ samaṃ hariḥ // RKK_64 //
children.translated_text: By that power, He plays with the <s>gopikās</s> (cowherd maidens) in separate forms simultaneously. // RKK_64 //

children.text: rādhayā saha rūpeṇa nijena ramate svayam /
children.translated_text: With <s>Rādhā</s>, He sports in His own original form;

children.text: iti mādhurya-līlāyāḥ śaktir neśatāyā hareḥ // RKK_65 //
children.translated_text: Thus the potency of <s>mādhurya-līlā</s> (sweet pastime) belongs to <s>Hari</s>, not to His lordly aspect. // RKK_65 //

children.text: jala-sekair mithas tatra krīḍitvā sa-gaṇau tataḥ /
children.translated_text: Having played there with mutual splashing of water, together with their companions, then

children.text: vāsaḥ-srak-candanair divya-bhūṣaṇair api bhūṣitau // RKK_66 //
children.translated_text: Adorned with garments, garlands, sandalwood paste, and divine ornaments, // RKK_66 //

children.text: tatraiva sarasas tīre divya-ratna-maye gṛhe /
children.translated_text: Right there on the bank of the lake, in a house made of divine jewels,

children.text: aśnītaḥ phala-mūlāni kalpitāni mayaiva hi // RKK_67 //
children.translated_text: They eat fruits and roots arranged by me alone. // RKK_67 //

children.text: haris tu prathamaṃ bhuktvā kāntayā pariveśitam /
children.translated_text: <s>Hari</s> first eats what is served by His beloved,

children.text: dvi-trābhiḥ sevito gacchec chayyāṃ puṣpa-vinirmitām // RKK_68 //
children.translated_text: Then, attended by two or three companions, He goes to a bed made of flowers. // RKK_68 //

children.text: tāmbūlair vyajanais tatra pāda-saṃvāhanādibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: There, with <s>tāmbūla</s> (betel), fans, foot-massage, and other services,

children.text: sevyamāno bhṛśantābhir moditaḥ preyasīṃ smaran // RKK_69 //
children.translated_text: Served diligently by those companions, He rejoices, remembering His beloved. // RKK_69 //

children.text: śrī-rādhāpi harau supte sa-gaṇā muditāntarā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Rādhā</s> too, when <s>Hari</s> has fallen asleep, joyful within, together with Her companions,

children.text: kānta-dattaṃ prīta-manā ucchiṣṭaṃ bubhuje tataḥ // RKK_70 //
children.translated_text: With a pleased heart, then eats the remnants given by Her beloved. // RKK_70 //

children.text: kiñcid evo tato bhuktvā vrajec chayyā-niketanam /
children.translated_text: Having eaten just a little, She goes to the bed-chamber

children.text: draṣṭuṃ kānta-mukhāmbhojaṃ cakorīvan niśā-karam // RKK_71 //
children.translated_text: To gaze upon the lotus face of Her beloved, like a <s>cakorī</s> bird gazing at the moon. // RKK_71 //

children.text: tāmbūla-carvitaṃ tasya tatratyābhir niveditam /
children.translated_text: The chewed <s>tāmbūla</s> (betel) of His, offered by the companions present there,

children.text: tāmbūlāny api cāśnāti vibhajanti priyāliṣu // RKK_72 //
children.translated_text: She also eats those betel preparations, which they distribute among the dear companions. // RKK_72 //

children.text: kṛṣṇo 'pi tāsāṃ śuśrūṣuḥ svacchandaṃ bhāṣitaṃ mithaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> too, wishing to observe their service, though speaking freely among them,

children.text: prāpta-nidra ivābhāti vinidro 'pi paṭāvṛtaḥ // RKK_73 //
children.translated_text: Appears as if He has fallen asleep, though actually awake, covered by a cloth. // RKK_73 //

children.text: tāś ca kṣvelīṃ kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā mithaḥ kānta-kathāśrayāḥ /
children.translated_text: And those companions, having jested for a moment among themselves, conversing about their beloved,

children.text: vyāja-nidrāṃ harer jñātvā kutaścid anumānataḥ // RKK_74 //
children.translated_text: Knowing <s>Hari</s>'s sleep to be feigned, through some inference, // RKK_74 //

children.text: vimṛśya vadanaṃ dṛgbhiḥ paśyantyo 'nyonya-mānanam /
children.translated_text: Examining His face, gazing at each other with their eyes in mutual acknowledgment,

children.text: līnā iva lajjayā syuḥ kṣaṇam ucur na kiñcanam // RKK_75 //
children.translated_text: As if hiding in embarrassment, they remain silent for a moment, saying nothing. // RKK_75 //

body.text: kṣaṇād eva tato vastraṃ dūrī-kṛtya tad aṅgataḥ /
body.translated_text: Then, after just a moment, pulling the cloth away from His body,

body.text: sādhu nidrāṃ gato 'sīti hāsayantyo hasanti tam // RKK_76 //
body.translated_text: Saying 'You have truly gone to sleep!', they make Him laugh and they themselves laugh. // RKK_76 //

children.text: evaṃ tau vividhair hāsai ramamāṇau gaṇaiḥ saha /
children.translated_text: Thus the two, enjoying themselves with their companions through various jests,

children.text: anubhūya kṣaṇaṃ nidrā-sukhaṃ ca muni-sattama // RKK_77 //
children.translated_text: And experiencing for a moment the bliss of sleep, O best of sages, // RKK_77 //

children.text: upaviśyāsane divye sa-gaṇau vistṛte mudā /
children.translated_text: Sitting joyfully upon a spacious divine seat, together with their companions,

children.text: paṇī-kṛtya mitho hāra-cumbāśleṣa-paricchadān // RKK_78 //
children.translated_text: Having wagered necklaces, kisses, embraces, and ornaments as stakes, // RKK_78 //

children.text: akṣair vikrīḍitaḥ premṇā narmālāpa-puraḥsaram /
children.translated_text: They play lovingly with dice, preceded by playful conversation;

children.text: parājito 'pi priyayā jitam ity avadan mṛṣā // RKK_79 //
children.translated_text: Though defeated by His beloved, He falsely declares 'I have won!' // RKK_79 //

children.text: hārādi-grahaṇe tasyāḥ pravṛttas tāḍyate tayā /
children.translated_text: When He proceeds to seize Her necklace and other ornaments, He is struck by Her;

children.text: tayaivaṃ tāḍitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ karṇotpala-saroruhaiḥ // RKK_80 //
children.translated_text: Thus struck by Her with lotus flowers from behind the ears, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> // RKK_80 //

children.text: viṣaṇḍa-vadano bhūtvā gata-sva iva nārada /
children.translated_text: Assumes a dejected face, as if bereft of his possessions, O <s>Nārada</s>,

children.text: jito 'smi ca tvayā devi gṛhyatāṃ yat paṇī-kṛtam // RKK_81 //
children.translated_text: 'I am defeated by You, O Goddess! Take what was wagered,' // RKK_81 //

children.text: cumbanādi mayā dattam ity uktvā ca tathācarat /
children.translated_text: 'Kisses and such I shall give,' saying thus, He acts accordingly,

children.text: kauṭilyaṃ tad-bhruvor draṣṭuṃ śrotuṃ tad-bhartsanaṃ vacaḥ // RKK_82 //
children.translated_text: In order to see the curve of Her eyebrows and to hear Her reproachful words. // RKK_82 //

children.text: tataḥ śārī-śukānāṃ ca śrutvā vāgāhavaṃ mithaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, hearing the verbal battle between the <s>śārī</s> (myna) birds and <s>śuka</s> (parrot) birds,

children.text: nirgacchatas tataḥ sthānād gantukāmo gṛhaṃ prati // RKK_83 //
children.translated_text: They depart from that place, desiring to go homeward. // RKK_83 //

children.text: kṛṣṇaḥ kāntām anujñāpya gavām abhimukhaṃ vrajet /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, taking leave of His beloved, goes toward the cows;

children.text: sā tu sūrya-gṛhaṃ gacchet sakhī-maṇḍala-saṃyutā // RKK_84 //
children.translated_text: She, accompanied by Her circle of <s>sakhīs</s>, goes to the temple of <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun). // RKK_84 //

children.text: kiyad-dūraṃ tato gatvā parāvṛtya hariḥ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having gone some distance, <s>Hari</s> turns back again,

children.text: vipra-veśaṃ samāsthāya yāti sūrya-gṛhaṃ prati // RKK_85 //
children.translated_text: Assuming the guise of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, He goes toward the temple of <s>Sūrya</s>. // RKK_85 //

children.text: sūryaṃ ca pūjayet tatra prārthitas tat-sakhī-janaiḥ /
children.translated_text: There, requested by the companions of that beloved, He worships <s>Sūrya</s>,

children.text: tad eva kalpitair vedaiḥ parihāsyāvagarbhitaiḥ // RKK_86 //
children.translated_text: With Vedic hymns composed for that very purpose, imbued with humor and jest. // RKK_86 //

children.text: tatas tā api taṃ kāntaṃ parijñāya vicakṣaṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: Then those clever companions, recognizing Him as the beloved,

children.text: ānanda-sāgare līnā na viduḥ svaṃ na cāparam // RKK_87 //
children.translated_text: Are immersed in an ocean of bliss, knowing neither themselves nor anything else. // RKK_87 //

children.text: vihārair vividhair evaṃ sārdha-yāma-dvayaṃ mune /
children.translated_text: Thus, with various pastimes, for two and a half <s>yāmas</s> (watches of time), O sage,

children.text: nītvā gṛhaṃ vajeṣus tāḥ sa ca kṛṣṇo gavāṃ vrajet // RKK_88 //
children.translated_text: Having spent the time, those companions go home, and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> goes to the cows. // RKK_88 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the midday service.

children.text: athāparāhna-sevā--
children.translated_text: Now the afternoon service:

children.text: saṅgamya tu sakhīn kṛṣṇo gṛhītvā gāḥ samantataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, meeting His cowherd friends and gathering the cows from all around,

children.text: āgacchati vrajaṃ karṣann uttāna-muralī-ravaiḥ // RKK_89 //
children.translated_text: Comes toward <s>Vraja</s>, drawing all with the upraised notes of His flute. // RKK_89 //

children.text: tato nandādayaḥ sarve śrutvā veṇu-ravaṃ hareḥ /
children.translated_text: Then <s>Nanda</s> and all the others, hearing the sound of <s>Hari</s>'s flute,

children.text: go-dhūli-paṭalair vyāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpi nabhaḥ-sthalam // RKK_90 //
children.translated_text: And seeing the sky pervaded by clouds of dust raised by the cows, // RKK_90 //

children.text: visṛjya sarva-karmāṇi striyo bālādayo 'pi ca /
children.translated_text: Abandoning all their tasks — women, children, and all others —

children.text: kṛṣṇasyābhimukhaṃ yānti tad-darśana-samutsukāḥ // RKK_91 //
children.translated_text: Go toward <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, eager for the sight of Him. // RKK_91 //

children.text: rādhikāpi samāgatya gṛhaṃ snātvā vibhūṣitā /
children.translated_text: <s>Rādhikā</s> too, having come home, having bathed and adorned Herself,

children.text: sampācya kānta-bhogārthaṃ dravyāṇi vividhāni ca /
children.translated_text: Having cooked various delicacies for Her beloved's enjoyment,

children.text: sakhī-saṃgha-yutā yānti kāntaṃ draṣṭuṃ samutsukāḥ // RKK_92 //
children.translated_text: Goes with Her group of <s>sakhīs</s>, eager to see Her beloved. // RKK_92 //

children.text: rāja-mārge vraja-dvāri yatra sarve vrajaukasaḥ /
children.translated_text: On the royal road, at the gate of <s>Vraja</s>, where all the residents of <s>Vraja</s> are gathered,

children.text: kṛṣṇo 'py etān samāgamya yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ // RKK_93 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> too, meeting all of them, properly and in due order, // RKK_93 //

children.text: darśanaiḥ sparśanair vāpi smita-purvāvalokanaiḥ /
children.translated_text: With glances, with touches, with smiles and looks,

children.text: gopa-vṛddhān namaskāraiḥ kāyikair vācikair api // RKK_94 //
children.translated_text: The elder cowherds with bodily and verbal salutations, // RKK_94 //

children.text: sāṣṭāṅga-pātaiḥ pitarau rohiṇīm api nārada /
children.translated_text: His parents and <s>Rohiṇī</s> with full prostrations, O <s>Nārada</s>,

children.text: netrānta-sūcitenaiva vinayena priyās tathā // RKK_95 //
children.translated_text: And His beloveds with modesty conveyed through the corners of His eyes — // RKK_95 //

children.text: evaṃ taiś ca yathā-yogyaṃ vrajaukobhiḥ prapūjitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus, duly honored by the residents of <s>Vraja</s> as befitting each,

children.text: gavālayaṃ tathā gāś ca sampraveśya samantataḥ // RKK_96 //
children.translated_text: Having led the cows into the cowshed from all sides, // RKK_96 //

children.text: pitṛbhyām arthito yāti bhrātrā saha nijālayam /
children.translated_text: Requested by His parents, He goes to His own home with His brother;

children.text: snātvā pitvā tathā kiñcid bhuktvā mātrānumoditaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having bathed, having drunk and eaten a little, with His mother's approval,

children.text: gavālayaṃ punar yāti dogdhu-kāmo gavāṃ payaḥ // RKK_97 //
children.translated_text: He goes again to the cowshed, desiring to milk the cows. // RKK_97 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the afternoon service.

children.text: atha sāyaṃ-sevā--
children.translated_text: Now the evening service:

children.text: tāś ca dugdhvā dohayitvā pāyayitvā ca kāścana /
children.translated_text: Having milked those cows, having had others milk them, and having fed some of them,

children.text: pitrā sārdhaṃ gṛhaṃ yāti payo-bhāri-śatānugaḥ // RKK_98 //
children.translated_text: He goes home with His father, followed by hundreds of vessels laden with milk. // RKK_98 //

children.text: tatrāpi mātṛ-vṛndaiś ca tat-putraiś ca balena ca /
children.translated_text: There too, with the groups of mothers and their sons and with <s>Bala</s> (<s>Balarāma</s>),

children.text: saṃbhuṅkte vividhānnāni carvya-cūṣyādikāni ca // RKK_99 //
children.translated_text: He partakes of various foods — solid, liquid, and other kinds. // RKK_99 //

children.text: atha pradoṣa-sevā--
children.translated_text: Now the early night service:

children.text: tan-mātuḥ prārthanāt pūrvaṃ rādhayāpi tadaiva hi /
children.translated_text: Even before the request of His mother, by <s>Rādhā</s> Herself at that very time,

children.text: prasthāpyante sakhī-dvārā pakvānnāni tad-ālayam // RKK_100 //
children.translated_text: Cooked dishes are sent through the <s>sakhīs</s> to His house. // RKK_100 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the evening service.

body.text: ślāghayaṃś ca haris tāni bhuktvā pitrādibhiḥ saha

children.text: sabhā-gṛhaṃ vrajet taiś ca juṣṭaṃ vandi-janādibhiḥ // RKK_101 //
children.translated_text: Goes to the assembly hall, attended by them and by bards and minstrels. // RKK_101 //

body.translated_text: And <s>Hari</s>, praising those dishes, having eaten with His father and others,

children.text: pakvānnāni gṛhītvā yāḥ sakhyas tatra samāgatāḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>sakhīs</s> who had come there carrying cooked dishes,

children.text: bahūni ca punas tāni pradattāni yaśodayā // RKK_102 //
children.translated_text: And the many additional dishes given to them by <s>Yaśodā</s>, // RKK_102 //

body.text: sakhyā tatra tayā dattaṃ kṛṣṇocchiṣṭaṃ tathā rahaḥ

children.text: sarvaṃ tābhiḥ samānīya rādhikāyai nivedyate // RKK_103 //
children.translated_text: All of this is brought by them and offered to <s>Rādhikā</s>. // RKK_103 //

body.translated_text: And the remnants of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>'s food, given secretly there by a particular <s>sakhī</s> —

children.text: sakhībhir maṇḍita tiṣṭhed abhisartuṃ mudānvitā // RKK_104 //
children.translated_text: Adorned by Her <s>sakhīs</s>, stands ready to go forth for the tryst, filled with joy. // RKK_104 //

body.translated_text: She too, having eaten, together with Her group of <s>sakhīs</s>, in due order,

children.text: prasthāpyate 'nayā kācid ita eva tataḥ sakhī /
children.translated_text: She sends forth a certain <s>sakhī</s> from here to there as a messenger,

children.text: tayābhisāritā sā 'tha yamunāyāḥ samīpataḥ // RKK_105 //
children.translated_text: Summoned by her, she [<s>Rādhā</s>] then, near the <s>Yamunā</s>, // RKK 105 //

children.text: kalpa-vṛksa-nikuñje 'smin divya-ratna-maye gṛhe /
children.translated_text: in this grove of wish-fulfilling trees, in a divine jewel-adorned abode,

children.text: sita-kṛṣṇa-niśāyogya-veśa yāti sakhī-yutā // RKK_106 //
children.translated_text: goes with her female companions (<s>sakhīs</s>), dressed appropriately for the bright and dark halves of the night. // RKK 106 //

children.text: kṛṣṇo 'pi vividhaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā kautuhalaṃ tataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> too, having seen various curiosities there,

children.text: kavitvāni manojñāni śrutvā ca gītakāny api // RKK_107 //
children.translated_text: and having heard charming poetic compositions and songs as well, // RKK 107 //

children.text: dhana-dhānyādibhis tāṃś ca prīṇayitvā vidhānataḥ /
children.translated_text: having pleased those [people] with wealth, grain, and so forth according to custom,

children.text: janair ākārito mātrā yāti śayyā-niketanam // RKK_108 //
children.translated_text: being called by his mother and [other] people, he goes to the bedroom. // RKK 108 //

children.text: mātari prasthitāyāntu bhojayitvā tato gṛhāt /
children.translated_text: But when his mother has departed, having fed [the household], then from the house

children.text: saṅketakaṃ kāntayātra samāgacched alakṣitaḥ // RKK_109 //
children.translated_text: he should come to the appointed meeting-place with his beloved, unobserved. // RKK 109 //

body.translated_text: Thus [ends] the evening service (<s>pradoṣa-sevā</s>).

children.text: atha rātri-sevā-
children.translated_text: Now the night service (<s>rātri-sevā</s>):

children.text: militvā tāv ubhāv atra krīḍato vana-rājiṣu /
children.translated_text: Having met, those two sport here in the rows of groves,

children.text: vihārair vividhair hāsya-lāsya-gīta-puraḥsaraiḥ // RKK_110 //
children.translated_text: with various diversions — laughter, dance, and song leading the way. // RKK 110 //

children.text: sārdha-yāma-dvayaṃ nītvā rātrer evaṃ vihārataḥ /
children.translated_text: Having passed two and a half <s>yāmas</s> (watches) of the night in such pastimes,

children.text: suṣupsū viśataḥ kuñjaṃ pañca-ṣābhir alakṣitau // RKK_111 //
children.translated_text: the two, desiring sleep, enter a bower, unobserved by five or six [companions]. // RKK 111 //

children.text: nirvṛnta-kusumaiḥ k pte keli-talpe manorame /
children.translated_text: On a delightful love-bed made of stemless flowers,

children.text: suptāvatiṣṭhatāṃ tatra sevyamānau priyālibhiḥ // RKK_112 //
children.translated_text: the two sleep and remain there, attended by [their] dear companions. // RKK 112 //

body.translated_text: Thus [ends] the night service (<s>rātri-sevā</s>).

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca--
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Nārada</s> said:

children.text: śrotum icchāmi bho deva vraja-rāja-sutasya ca /
children.translated_text: I wish to hear, O Lord, about the son of the king of <s>Vraja</s>,

children.text: vṛndāvane rasaṃ divyaṃ rādhayaikāntikaṃ saha // RKK_113 //
children.translated_text: the divine <s>rasa</s> (aesthetic rapture) of exclusive [union] with <s>Rādhā</s> in <s>Vṛndāvana</s>. // RKK 113 //

children.text: śrī-sadāśiva uvāca--
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Sadāśiva</s> said:

children.text: śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi rādhā-kṛṣṇa-rasaṃ śuciṃ /
children.translated_text: Listen, <s>Nārada</s>, I shall speak of the pure <s>rasa</s> of <s>Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>,

children.text: su-gopyaṃ paramodāraṃ na vaktavyaṃ hi kasyacit // RKK_114 //
children.translated_text: which is to be kept very secret, supremely generous, and not to be told to anyone. // RKK 114 //

children.text: aikāntika-rasāsvādaṃ kartuṃ vṛndāvane mune /
children.translated_text: In order to taste the exclusive <s>rasa</s> in <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, O sage,

children.text: vraja-rāja-kumāraṃ ca bahu-kālam abhāvayam // RKK_115 //
children.translated_text: I meditated upon the prince of <s>Vraja</s> for a very long time. // RKK 115 //

children.text: mayi prasannaḥ śrī-kṛṣṇo mantra-yugmam anuttamam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, pleased with me, [gave me] a pair of unsurpassed <s>mantras</s>,

children.text: yugalākhyaṃ dadau mahyaṃ svīyojjvala-rasāplutam // RKK_116 //
children.translated_text: called the 'couple' (<s>yugala</s>), and bestowed upon me [those mantras] flooded with his own radiant <s>rasa</s>. // RKK 116 //

children.text: samabravīt tadā kṛṣṇaḥ sva-śiṣyaṃ māṃ svakaṃ rasam /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> then spoke to me, his own disciple, about his own <s>rasa</s>:

children.text: bravīmi tvāṃ śṛṇuṣvādya brahmādīnām agocaram // RKK_117 //
children.translated_text: 'I tell you — listen now — [that which is] beyond the reach of <s>Brahmā</s> and the other [gods]. // RKK 117 //

children.text: vraja-rāja-suto vṛndā-vane pūrṇatamo vasan /
children.translated_text: The son of the king of <s>Vraja</s>, dwelling most fully in <s>Vṛndāvana</s>,

children.text: sampūrṇa-ṣoḍaśa-kalā vihāraṃ kurute sadā // RKK_118 //
children.translated_text: possessing all sixteen <s>kalās</s> (digits of perfection), always performs his pastimes. // RKK 118 //

children.text: vāsudevaḥ pūrṇataro mathurāyāṃ vasan puri /
children.translated_text: <s>Vāsudeva</s>, more full [but not the fullest], dwelling in the city of <s>Mathurā</s>,

children.text: kalābhiḥ pañca-daśabhir yutaḥ krīḍati sarvadā // RKK_119 //
children.translated_text: endowed with fifteen <s>kalās</s>, plays at all times. // RKK 119 //

children.text: dvārakādhipatir dvāra-vatyāṃ pūrṇas tv asau vasan /
children.translated_text: The lord of <s>Dvārakā</s>, full, dwelling in <s>Dvāravatī</s>,

children.text: catur-daśa-kalāyukto viharaty eva sarvadā // RKK_120 //
children.translated_text: endowed with fourteen <s>kalās</s>, sports at all times. // RKK 120 //

children.text: ekayā kalayā dvābhyāṃ mathurā-dvārakādhipau /
children.translated_text: By one <s>kalā</s> and by two <s>kalās</s>, the lords of <s>Mathurā</s> and <s>Dvārakā</s>

children.text: vṛndāvana-pate rūpau pūrṇau sve sve pade rase // RKK_121 //
children.translated_text: [are less than] the forms of the lord of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, [each being] full in their own station and <s>rasa</s>. // RKK 121 //

body.text:
mathurā-nātho vṛndāvanādhipāpekṣayā svarūpeṇa līlayā ca ekayā kalayā ūnaḥ /
mathurā-līlāyāṃ mathurāyāṃ ca sampūrṇa-ṣoḍaśa-kalaḥ /
tathā dvārakā-nātho vṛndāvanādhipāpekṣayā svarūpeṇa līlayā ca /
dvābhyāṃ kalābhyām ūnaḥ /
dvārakāyāṃ dvārakā-līlāyāṃ ca pūrṇa-ṣoḍaśa-kalaḥ /
body.translated_text: The lord of <s>Mathurā</s>, in comparison with the lord of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, is lesser by one <s>kalā</s> in his essential form and pastimes; but in the <s>Mathurā</s> pastimes and in <s>Mathurā</s>, he has the full sixteen <s>kalās</s>. Likewise, the lord of <s>Dvārakā</s>, in comparison with the lord of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, is lesser by two <s>kalās</s> in his essential form and pastimes; but in <s>Dvārakā</s> and in the <s>Dvārakā</s> pastimes, he has the full sixteen <s>kalās</s>.

children.text: śrīr bhū-līlā yogamāyā cintyācintyā tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī</s> (fortune), <s>Bhū</s> (earth), <s>Līlā</s> (play), <s>Yogamāyā</s>, <s>Cintyā</s> (conceivable), <s>Acintyā</s> (inconceivable), likewise

children.text: mohinī kauśalīty aṣṭau bahiraṅgāś ca śaktayaḥ // RKK_122 //
children.translated_text: <s>Mohinī</s> (enchanting) and <s>Kauśalī</s> (skillful) — these are the eight external powers (<s>bahiraṅga-śaktis</s>). // RKK 122 //

children.text: līlā prema-svarūpā casthāpany ākarṣaṇī tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Līlā</s>, <s>Prema-svarūpā</s> (whose form is love), <s>Sthāpanī</s> (the establishing [power]), <s>Ākarṣaṇī</s> (the attracting [power]),

children.text: saṃyoginī viyoginyā-hlādinīty antaraṅgikā // RKK_123 //
children.translated_text: <s>Saṃyoginī</s> (the uniting [power]), <s>Viyoginī</s> (the separating [power]), and <s>Hlādinī</s> (the delighting [power]) — these are the internal [powers]. // RKK 123 //

children.text: vraje śrī-kṛṣṇa-candrasya santi ṣoḍaśa-śaktayaḥ /
children.translated_text: In <s>Vraja</s>, <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇacandra</s> has sixteen powers (<s>śaktis</s>);

children.text: poṣikā madhurasyaiva tasyaitā vai sanātanāḥ // RKK_124 //
children.translated_text: these, which nourish the sweetness (<s>mādhurya</s>) [rasa], are indeed eternal. // RKK 124 //

children.text: hlādinī ya mahā-śaktiḥ sarva-śakti-varīyasī /
children.translated_text: <s>Hlādinī</s>, the great power, the most excellent of all powers —

children.text: tat-sāra-bhāva-rūpā śrī-rādhikā parikīrtitā // RKK_125 //
children.translated_text: she whose form is the essence of that [<s>hlādinī</s>], Śrī <s>Rādhikā</s>, is celebrated. // RKK 125 //

children.text: tayā śrī-kṛṣṇa-candrasya kriḍāyāḥ samaye mune /
children.translated_text: By her, at the time of play of <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇacandra</s>, O sage,

children.text: tad-āviṣṭaṃ vāsudevaṃ saha kṣīrābdhi-nāyakam // RKK_126 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vāsudeva</s>, who is possessed by him, together with the lord of the milk-ocean [<s>Viṣṇu</s>], // RKK 126 //

children.text: antarīkṣya-gataṃ kuryāc chaktir ākarṣaṇī hareḥ /
children.translated_text: the attracting power (<s>ākarṣaṇī śakti</s>) of <s>Hari</s> would cause to go into the atmosphere;

children.text: krīḍānte sthāpayet tantu sthāpanī kṛṣṇa-dehataḥ // RKK_127 //
children.translated_text: at the end of play, the establishing power (<s>sthāpanī</s>) would restore [them] to <s>Kṛṣṇa's</s> body. // RKK 127 //

children.text: sampūrṇa-ṣoḍaśa-kalaḥ kevalo nanda-nandanaḥ /
children.translated_text: The son of <s>Nanda</s>, possessing the full sixteen <s>kalās</s>, alone,

children.text: vikrīḍan rādhayā sārdhaṃ labhate paramaṃ sukham // RKK_128 //
children.translated_text: sporting with <s>Rādhā</s>, obtains supreme bliss. // RKK 128 //

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca--
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Nārada</s> said:

children.text: gate madhu-purīṃ kṛṣṇe vipralambha-rasaḥ katham /
children.translated_text: When <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> went to <s>Madhupurī</s> (<s>Mathurā</s>), how [was] the <s>rasa</s> of separation (<s>vipralambha</s>)

children.text: vāsudeve rādhikāyāḥ saṃśayaṃ chindhi me prabho // RKK_129 //
children.translated_text: of <s>Rādhikā</s> regarding <s>Vāsudeva</s>? Resolve my doubt, O lord. // RKK 129 //

children.text: śrī-sadāśiva uvāca--
children.translated_text: Śrī <s>Sadāśiva</s> said:

children.text: śaktiḥ saṃyoginī kāmā vāmā śaktir viyoginī /
children.translated_text: The power <s>Saṃyoginī</s> (uniting) is called <s>Kāmā</s>; the left-natured (<s>vāmā</s>) power is <s>Viyoginī</s> (separating);

children.text: hlādinī kīrtidā-putrī caivaṃ rādhā-trayaṃ vraje // RKK_130 //
children.translated_text: <s>Hlādinī</s> is the daughter of <s>Kīrtidā</s> — thus there is a triad of <s>Rādhās</s> in <s>Vraja</s>. // RKK 130 //

children.text: mama prāṇeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇas tyaktvā vṛndāvanaṃ kvacit /
children.translated_text: 'My life-lord <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, having abandoned <s>Vṛndāvana</s>,

children.text: kadācin naiva yātīti jānīte kīrtidā-sutā // RKK_131 //
children.translated_text: never goes anywhere ever' — this the daughter of <s>Kīrtidā</s> knows. // RKK 131 //

children.text: kāmā-vāme na jānīta iti ca brahma-nandana /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāmā</s> and <s>Vāmā</s> do not know this — thus, O son of <s>Brahmā</s>,

children.text: rāsārambha ivāntardhiṃ gatavān nanda-nandanaḥ // RKK_132 //
children.translated_text: [when] the son of <s>Nanda</s> disappeared, as at the beginning of the <s>rāsa</s>-dance, // RKK 132 //

children.text: mathurāṃ mathurā-nātho vāsudevo jagāma ha /
children.translated_text: <s>Vāsudeva</s>, the lord of <s>Mathurā</s>, went to <s>Mathurā</s>;

children.text: antar-hite nanda-sute śrīmad-vṛndāvane mune // RKK_133 //
children.translated_text: when the son of <s>Nanda</s> disappeared in the glorious <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, O sage, // RKK 133 //

children.text: pravāsākhyaṃ rasaṃ lebhe rādhā vai kīrtidā-sutā /
children.translated_text: <s>Rādhā</s>, the daughter of <s>Kīrtidā</s>, experienced the <s>rasa</s> called 'absence' (<s>pravāsa</s>);

children.text: tato vadanti munayaḥ pravāsaṃ saṅga-vicyutim // RKK_134 //
children.translated_text: therefore the sages speak of 'absence' as separation from the beloved's company. // RKK 134 //

children.text: mama jīvana-netā ca tyaktvā māṃ mathurāṃ gataḥ /
children.translated_text: 'The leader of my life has abandoned me and gone to <s>Mathurā</s>' —

children.text: iti vihvalitā vāmā rādhā yā virahād abhūt // RKK_135 //
children.translated_text: thus <s>Vāmā Rādhā</s>, who became agitated from separation. // RKK 135 //

children.text: yamunāyāṃ nimagnā sā prakāśaṃ gokulasya ca /
children.translated_text: She, submerged in the <s>Yamunā</s>, [and then in] the radiance of <s>Gokula</s>,

children.text: golakaṃ prāpya tatrābhūt saṃyoga-rasa-peśalā // RKK_136 //
children.translated_text: reaching <s>Goloka</s>, there became skilled in the <s>rasa</s> of union (<s>saṃyoga-rasa</s>). // RKK 136 //

children.text: kāmā rādhā ca mathurā-viraheṇa nipīḍitā /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāmā Rādhā</s>, tormented by separation from <s>Mathurā</s> [Kṛṣṇa],

children.text: kurukṣetraṃ gatā tīrtha-yātrā-parama-lālasā // RKK_137 //
children.translated_text: went to <s>Kurukṣetra</s>, greatly eager for pilgrimage. // RKK 137 //

children.text: nanda-nandana-bhāva-jña uddhavo vrajam āgataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Uddhava</s>, who understood the mood of the son of <s>Nanda</s>, came to <s>Vraja</s>

children.text: sāntvayiṣyan kīrtidāyāḥ sutāṃ māsa-dvaye gate // RKK_138 //
children.translated_text: to console the daughter of <s>Kīrtidā</s>, when two months had passed. // RKK 138 //

children.text: rādhām āsvādayāmāsa śrīmad-bhāgavatārthakaṃ /
children.translated_text: He caused <s>Rādhā</s> to relish the meaning of the <s>Śrīmad Bhāgavata</s>;

children.text: kathāyāṃ bhāgavatyāntu jātāyāṃ muni-puṅgava // RKK_139 //
children.translated_text: and when the discourse on the <s>Bhāgavata</s> arose, O best of sages, // RKK 139 //

body.text: vrajendra-nandanaḥ śrīmāṃs tadā pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ // RKK_140 //
body.translated_text: the glorious son of the king of <s>Vraja</s> then became directly visible. // RKK 140 //

body.text:
ataeva pādmottara-khaṇḍoktaṃ dvārakādhipater vṛndāvanaṃ prati-gamanaṃ kṣīrābdhiśāyy āviṣṭatvāt kṣīrābdhiśāyino droṇādīnāṃ labdha-vara-tvāt, teṣāṃ punaḥ sva-sthāna-prāpaṇārtham evety avagantavyam /
śrīmad-bhāgavata-vākyānām evaṃ vicāro 'vagantavyaḥ padmottara-khaṇḍe tu ôkālindi-puline ramyeö ity atra śrī-dvārakā-nāthasya śrī-nanda-nandana-madhura-līlā-saṃdarśane sotkaṇṭhatvād vyoma-yānair etya śrī-vṛndāvane māsa-dvayam uvāsety abhiprāyo jñeyaḥ /
tad yathā śrī-lalita-mādhave (8.34)--ôaparikalita-pūrvaḥö ityādi /
body.translated_text: [Commentary:] Therefore, the going of the lord of <s>Dvārakā</s> to <s>Vṛndāvana</s> as described in the <s>Padma</s>-<s>Uttara-khaṇḍa</s> should be understood as being due to the lord of the milk-ocean [<s>Viṣṇu</s>] having entered [<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>], and because <s>Droṇa</s> and others had received boons, [that journey was] solely for the purpose of restoring them to their own abodes. The investigation of the statements of the <s>Śrīmad Bhāgavata</s> should be understood thus. In the <s>Padma-Uttara-khaṇḍa</s>, the verse 'On the beautiful bank of the <s>Kālindī</s>' — the purport should be known as follows: the lord of <s>Śrī Dvārakā</s>, being eager to see the sweet pastimes of <s>Śrī Nanda-nandana</s>, came by aerial vehicle and dwelt in <s>Śrī Vṛndāvana</s> for two months. As in the <s>Śrī Lalita-Mādhava</s> (8.34): 'Previously unknown' and so forth.

children.text: iti te sarvam ākhyātaṃ naityikaṃ caritaṃ hareḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus all has been told to you — the daily conduct of <s>Hari</s>,

children.text: pāpino 'pi vimucyante smaraṇād yasya nārada // RKK_141 //
children.translated_text: by the remembrance of which even sinners are liberated, O <s>Nārada</s>. // RKK 141 //

children.text: aṣṭa-kālokta-śuśrūṣā-nantaraṃ sādhakaḥ kramāt /
children.translated_text: After the service described for the eight time-periods, the practitioner (<s>sādhaka</s>), in order,

children.text: dvātriṃśad-akṣara-mukhyān japen mantrān atandritaḥ // RKK_142 //
children.translated_text: should chant the principal thirty-two-syllable <s>mantras</s> diligently. // RKK 142 //

children.text: mahā-mantraṃ japed ādau daśārṇaṃ tad-anantaram /
children.translated_text: First one should chant the <s>mahā-mantra</s>, then the ten-syllable [<s>mantra</s>],

children.text: tataḥ śrī-rādhikā-mantraṃ gāyatrīṃ kāmakīṃ tathā // RKK_143 //
children.translated_text: then the <s>mantra</s> of <s>Śrī Rādhikā</s>, the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, and the <s>Kāmakī</s> [mantra]. // RKK 143 //

children.text: tato yugala-mantraṃ ca japed rāsa-sthalī-pradam /
children.translated_text: Then one should chant the couple-<s>mantra</s> (<s>yugala-mantra</s>), which bestows the <s>rāsa</s>-ground;

children.text: tato 'ṣṭānāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca japen mantrān yathā-kramam /
children.translated_text: then one should chant the <s>mantras</s> of the eight <s>sakhīs</s> (female companions) in sequence,

children.text: tataḥ ṣaṇ-mañjarīṇāṃ ca sva-sva-mantrān kramāj japet // RKK_144 //
children.translated_text: then one should chant the <s>mantras</s> of the six <s>mañjarīs</s> (bud-like attendants), each one's own <s>mantra</s> in order. // RKK 144 //

children.text: yathā ādi-purāṇe--
children.translated_text: As in the <s>Ādi-purāṇa</s>:

children.text: gopī-bhāvena ye bhaktā mām eva paryupāsate /
children.translated_text: 'Those devotees who worship me alone with the mood of a <s>gopī</s> (cowherd woman),

children.text: teṣu tāsv iva tuṣṭo 'smi satyaṃ satyaṃ dhanañjaya // RKK_145 //
children.translated_text: with them I am pleased just as with those [<s>gopīs</s>] — truly, truly, O <s>Dhanañjaya</s>! // RKK 145 //

children.text: veśa-bhūṣā-vayo-rūpair gopikā-bhāvam āśritāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who have taken refuge in the mood of the <s>gopīs</s> through dress, ornaments, age, and form,

children.text: bhāvukīyāś ca tad-bhāvaṃ yānti pāda-rajo 'rcanāt // RKK_146 //
children.translated_text: and the devotees attain that mood through the worship of the dust of [their] feet. // RKK 146 //

children.text: yathā ekāmra-purāṇe--
children.translated_text: As in the <s>Ekāmra-purāṇa</s>:

children.text: aho bhajana-māhātmyaṃ vṛndāvana-pater hareḥ /
children.translated_text: Ah, the greatness of the worship of <s>Hari</s>, the lord of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>!

children.text: pumān yoṣid bhaved yatra yoṣid-ātma-samānikā // RKK_147 //
children.translated_text: A man becomes a woman there, [and] a woman becomes equal to him in nature. // RKK 147 //

children.text: pādme ca (uttara-khaṇḍe)--
children.translated_text: And in the <s>Padma</s> [Purāṇa] (<s>Uttara-khaṇḍa</s>):

children.text: purā maharṣayaḥ sarve daṇḍakāraṇya-vāsinaḥ /
children.translated_text: Formerly, all the great sages dwelling in the <s>Daṇḍakāraṇya</s> forest,

children.text: rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ tatra bhoktum aicchan su-vigraham // RKK_148 //
children.translated_text: having seen <s>Rāma</s>, <s>Hari</s>, desired to enjoy his beautiful form. // RKK 148 //

children.text: te sarve strītvam āpannāḥ samudbhūtāś ca gokule /
children.translated_text: They all attained womanhood and were born in <s>Gokula</s>;

children.text: hariṃ samprāpya kāmena tato muktā bhavārṇavāt // RKK_149 //
children.translated_text: having attained <s>Hari</s> through desire, they were then liberated from the ocean of existence. // RKK 149 //

children.text: bṛhad-vāmana-siddhāś ca śrutayo 'pi yathā purā /
children.translated_text: The <s>Bṛhad-vāmana</s>-accomplished ones and the <s>Śrutis</s> (Vedic texts) too, as in former times,

children.text: gopī-bhāvena saṃsevya samudbhūtā hi gokule // RKK_150 //
children.translated_text: by serving [<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>] with the mood of <s>gopīs</s>, were born in <s>Gokula</s>. // RKK 150 //

children.text: yad-uktaṃ śrī-rūpa-gosvāmi-caraṇaiḥ--
children.translated_text: As stated by the venerable <s>Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī</s>:

children.text: hariṃ su-rāga-mārgeṇa sevate yo narottamaḥ /
children.translated_text: That best among men who serves <s>Hari</s> through the path of intense attachment (<s>su-rāga-mārga</s>),

children.text: kevalenaiva sa tadā gopikātvam iyād vraje // RKK_151 //
children.translated_text: he alone then attains the state of being a <s>gopī</s> in <s>Vraja</s>. // RKK 151 //

children.text: bhakti-tattva-kaumudyām--
children.translated_text: In the <s>Bhakti-tattva-kaumudī</s>:

children.text: ekasmin vāsanā-dehe yadi cānyasya bhāvanā /
children.translated_text: If in a single subtle body there is the contemplation of another [form] —

children.text: tarhi tat sāmyam eva syāt yathā vai bharate nṛpe // RKK_152 //
children.translated_text: then there would be equality with that, just as in the case of king <s>Bharata</s>. // RKK_152 //

children.text: śrī-nārada uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Nārada</s> said—

children.text: dhanyo 'smy anugṛhīto 'smi tvayā devi na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: I am blessed, I am graced by you, O Goddess, without doubt;

children.text: harer me naityikī līlā yato me 'dya prakāśitā // RKK_153 //
children.translated_text: for the daily pastimes of <s>Hari</s> have been revealed to me today. // RKK_153 //

body.translated_text: As in the <s>Sanat-kumāra Saṃhitā</s>—

children.text: śrī-sanat-kumāra uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Sanat-kumāra</s> said—

children.text: ity uktvā tāṃ parikramya tayā cāpi prapūjitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having said this and circumambulated her, and also having been worshipped by her,

children.text: antardhānaṃ gato rājan nārado muni-sattamaḥ // RKK_154 //
children.translated_text: <s>Nārada</s>, the best of sages, disappeared, O king. // RKK_154 //

children.text: mayāpy etad ānupūrvyaṃ sarvaṃ tat parikīrtitam /
children.translated_text: By me too, all this has been narrated in sequence;

children.text: japan nityaṃ prayatnena mantra-yugmam anuttamam // RKK_155 //
children.translated_text: always chanting with effort the unsurpassed pair of <s>mantras</s>, // RKK_155 //

children.text: kṛṣṇa-vaktrād idaṃ labdhaṃ purā rudreṇa yatnataḥ /
children.translated_text: this was obtained from the mouth of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, formerly by <s>Rudra</s> with great effort;

children.text: tenoktaṃ nāradāyātha nāradena mayoditam // RKK_156 //
children.translated_text: by him it was told to <s>Nārada</s>, and by <s>Nārada</s> it was told to me. // RKK_156 //

children.text: saṃsārāgni-vināśāya mayāpy etat tavoditam /
children.translated_text: For the destruction of the fire of <s>saṃsāra</s>, by me too this has been told to you;

children.text: tvayā caitad gopanīyaṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam // RKK_157 //
children.translated_text: and this supremely wondrous secret should be kept hidden by you. // RKK_157 //

children.text: śrī-ambarīṣa uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Ambarīṣa</s> said—

children.text: kṛta-kṛtyo 'bhavaṃ sākṣāt tvat prasādād ahaṃ guro /
children.translated_text: I have become truly fulfilled by your grace, O <s>Guru</s>;

children.text: rahasyātirahasyaṃ yat tvayā mahyaṃ prakāśitam // RKK_158 //
children.translated_text: that which is the most secret of secrets has been revealed to me by you. // RKK_158 //

children.text: śrī-sanat-kumāra uvāca--
children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Sanat-kumāra</s> said—

children.text: dharmān etān upādiṣṭo japan mantram ahar niśam /
children.translated_text: Having been instructed in these <s>dharmas</s>, chanting the <s>mantra</s> day and night,

children.text: acirād eva tad-dāsyam avāpsyasi na saṃśayaḥ // RKK_159 //
children.translated_text: you will very soon attain service to Them—there is no doubt. // RKK_159 //

body.text: ôetān dharmān--aṣṭa-kāla-sevā-rūpān; mantram--yugala-mantram; tad-dāsyam--tayoḥ śrī-rādhā-kṛṣṇayor dāsyaṃ dāsī-bhāvamö iti /
body.translated_text: [Commentary:] 'These dharmas'—in the form of service during the eight time periods; 'the mantra'—the <s>yugala-mantra</s> (couple-mantra); 'service to Them'—service to <s>Śrī Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the state of being a maidservant.

children.text: mayāpi gamyate rājan guror āyatanaṃ mama /
children.translated_text: I too am going, O king, to the abode of my <s>Guru</s>;

children.text: vṛndāvane yatra nityaṃ gurur me 'sti sadāśivaḥ // RKK_160 //
children.translated_text: in <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, where my eternal <s>Guru</s>, <s>Sadāśiva</s>, resides. // RKK_160 //

body.text: dvātriṃśad-akṣarādīnāṃ mantrāṇāṃ krameṇa phalaṃ yathā pādme--
body.translated_text: The fruits of the <s>mantras</s> beginning with the thirty-two syllables, in order, as in the <s>Padma</s> [Purāṇa]—

children.text: dvātriṃśad-akṣaraṃ mantraṃ nāma-ṣoḍaśakānvitam /
children.translated_text: The thirty-two-syllable <s>mantra</s>, consisting of the sixteen names,

children.text: prajapan vaiṣṇavo nityaṃ rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sthalaṃ labhet // RKK_161 //
children.translated_text: a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> who constantly chants it shall attain the abode of <s>Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // RKK_161 //

children.text: gautamīya-tantre ca--
children.translated_text: And in the <s>Gautamīya Tantra</s>—

children.text: ahar-niśaṃ japen mantraṃ mantrī niyata-mānasaḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>mantra</s>-practitioner should chant the <s>mantra</s> day and night with a controlled mind;

children.text: sa paśyati na sandeho gopa-rūpiṇam īśvaram // RKK_162 //
children.translated_text: he will behold the Lord in the form of a cowherd—there is no doubt. // RKK_162 //

children.text: gaurī-tantre ca--
children.translated_text: And in the <s>Gaurī Tantra</s>—

children.text: śrīmad-aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ rādhāyāḥ prema-siddhi-dam /
children.translated_text: The auspicious eight-syllable <s>mantra</s> of <s>Rādhā</s>, which bestows the perfection of <s>prema</s> (divine love),

children.text: prajapet sādhako yas tu sa rādhāntikam āpnuyāt // RKK_163 //
children.translated_text: the practitioner who chants it shall attain proximity to <s>Rādhā</s>. // RKK_163 //

children.text: sanat-kumāra-saṃhitāyām--
children.translated_text: In the <s>Sanat-kumāra Saṃhitā</s>—

children.text: japed yaḥ kāma-gāyatrīṃ kāma-bīja-samanvitām /
children.translated_text: One who chants the <s>Kāma-gāyatrī</s>, endowed with the <s>Kāma-bīja</s> (seed syllable of desire),

children.text: tasya siddhir bhavet prema rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sthalaṃ vrajet // RKK_164 //
children.translated_text: his perfection shall be <s>prema</s> (divine love), and he shall go to the abode of <s>Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // RKK_164 //

children.text: etāṃ pañca-padīṃ japtvā śraddhayā 'śraddhayāsakṛt /
children.translated_text: Having chanted this five-part [mantra] with faith or even without faith, repeatedly,

children.text: vṛndāvane tayor dāsyaṃ gacchaty eva na saṃśayaḥ // RKK_165 //
children.translated_text: one attains service to those two in <s>Vṛndāvana</s>—there is no doubt. // RKK_165 //

children.text: kiśorī-tantre ca--
children.translated_text: And in the <s>Kiśorī Tantra</s>—

children.text: etān sakhīnām aṣṭānāṃ mantrān yaḥ sādhako japet /
children.translated_text: The practitioner who chants the <s>mantras</s> of these eight <s>sakhīs</s>

children.text: śrī-rādhā-kṛṣṇayoḥ kṣipraṃ vihāra-sthalam āpnuyāt // RKK_166 //
children.translated_text: shall quickly attain the pastime-place of <s>Śrī Rādhā</s> and <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // RKK_166 //

children.text: tatraiva--
children.translated_text: In the same [text]—

children.text: mantrān etān mañjarīṇām aṣṭānāṃ yo japet sadā /
children.translated_text: One who always chants the <s>mantras</s> of the eight <s>mañjarīs</s>,

children.text: prema-siddhir bhavet tasya śrī-vṛndāvanam āpnuyāt // RKK_167 //
children.translated_text: the perfection of <s>prema</s> (divine love) shall be his, and he shall attain <s>Śrī Vṛndāvana</s>. // RKK_167 //

children.text: smaraṇānantaraṃ siddha-dehasyaiva ca sādhakaḥ /
children.translated_text: After the remembrance, the practitioner, with the <s>siddha-deha</s> (perfected body) itself,

children.text: aṣṭa-kāloditāṃ līlāṃ saṃsmaret sādhakāṅgakaḥ // RKK_168 //
children.translated_text: should remember the pastimes described in the eight time periods, as a practitioner-bodied [being]. // RKK_168 //

children.text: kālau niśānta-pūrvāhnāv aparāhna-pradoṣakau /
children.translated_text: The periods of <s>niśānta</s> (late night) and <s>pūrvāhna</s> (forenoon), <s>aparāhna</s> (afternoon) and <s>pradoṣa</s> (early night),

children.text: vijñeyau tri-tri-ghaṭikau prātaḥ sāyaṃ dvayaṃ dvayam // RKK_169 //
children.translated_text: should be known as three <s>ghaṭikās</s> each; <s>prātaḥ</s> (morning) and <s>sāyam</s> (evening) as two each. // RKK_169 //

body.translated_text: <s>Madhyāhna</s> (midday) and <s>rātrikā</s> (night) should be known as two [and a half] <s>ghaṭikās</s> each. // RKK_170 //

children.text: eteṣu samayeṣv evaṃ yā yā līlā puroditā /
children.translated_text: In these time periods, whichever pastimes have been described above,

children.text: tāṃ tām eva yathā-kālaṃ saṃsmaret sādhako janaḥ // RKK_171 //
children.translated_text: those very ones the practitioner should remember at the appropriate time. // RKK_171 //

body.translated_text: Thus ends the Manual of the Procedure for Remembering the Pastimes of <s>Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa</s> in the Eight Time Periods, composed by <s>Śrī Dhyānacandra Gosvāmī</s>.
